adventure.title: B2: The Keep on the Borderlands

narrative.playerFacingDescription: Two 30ft high stone towers with battlements flank a heavy 20ft gatehouse equipped with iron-reinforced portcullis.
gmNotes: Guarded by Corporal of the Guard and 6 guards. Entrants must state business.

npcs.name: The Castellan
npcs.dialogueText: Welcome to the Keep on the Borderlands. Keep the realm safe from the forces of Chaos lurking in the ravine.

npcs.name: The Bailiff
npcs.dialogueText: State your business at the Keep. Pay your taxes and obey the law of the Realm.

npcs.name: Corporal of the Guard
npcs.dialogueText: Halt! Who goes there? State your name and business before entering the Keep.

npcs.name: The Mad Hermit
npcs.dialogueText: Beware the Caves of Chaos! The dark gods call for blood!

items.name: Iron Gate Key
items.description: Heavy wrought-iron key forged in the Keep smithy.

items.name: Brass Chest Key
items.description: Small ornate bronze-alloy key found on the Kobold Chieftain.

items.name: Silver Key
items.description: Ornate silver-plated steel key worn on a thong around the Ogre's neck.

items.name: Chaos Talisman
items.description: Unholy talisman of cast pig-iron depicting the sprawling eight-pointed symbol of Chaos.

items.name: Ring of Protection +1
items.description: A fine mithral band glowing with protective abjuration warding.

items.name: Potion of Healing
items.description: Vial of crimson restorative elixir sealed with red wax.

items.name: Longsword +1
items.description: Well-balanced longsword forged of tempered steel with razor keenness.

items.name: Shield +1
items.description: Steel heater shield emblazoned with the Keep's falcon crest and warding runes.

items.name: Potion of Invisibility
items.description: Clear shimmering liquid that renders the imbiber invisible.

items.name: Iron Crowbar
items.description: Sturdy iron pry bar. Grants +2 circumstance bonus on Strength checks to burst open stuck doors and chests.

items.name: Thieves' Tools
items.description: Set of fine steel picks, skeleton keys, and tension bars for manipulating locks.

items.name: Flask of Bladefire
items.description: Adhesive liquid that coats blades with searing blue fire for 1d6 rounds (+1 fire damage).

items.name: Flask of Stonebreaker Acid
items.description: Emerald-green corrosive acid that eats through stone structures, dealing 3d10 damage and ignoring hardness.

items.name: Gravebane Pellet
items.description: Aromatic incense repelling undead creatures within a 5-foot radius (DC 12 Will save).

items.name: Golden Goblet
items.description: Chased golden goblet set with garnets.

items.name: Scroll of Radiant Light
items.description: Parchment scroll containing an ancient light incantation.

quests.title: Clear the Caves of Chaos
quests.description: Eradicate the evil humanoids lurking in the ravine to secure the Borderlands.

quests.title: Vanquish the Shrine of Chaos
quests.description: Defeat the High Priest of Chaos in the deep temple catacombs.
